name: Scan Parsers
description: Bundled pack (SPEC-AI-ERA-PLUGINS Gap 1): parse structured scanner output (nmap greppable, nuclei JSONL) into typed scanner.scan_result timeline events. Runs no code inside RedLog — the parser is a shell-side pipe stage that POSTs to the local API.
author: RedLog

targetExtractors.name: nuclei-target
targetExtractors.description: Extracts the host from a `nuclei -u <url>` invocation

targetExtractors.name: nmap-target-ip
targetExtractors.description: Extracts an IPv4 / CIDR target from an nmap or masscan command

capture.name: nmap → scan_result
capture.description: Pipe nmap greppable output through the parser so each host+ports lands as a scanner.scan_result event.

manualSteps.label: Run your scan through the wrapper (it echoes nmap's output and captures it)
Or pipe an existing greppable scan file

capture.name: nuclei → scan_result
capture.description: Pipe nuclei JSONL output through the parser so each finding lands as a scanner.scan_result event (severity recorded as the tool reported it).
